name: ado-pr
description: Azure DevOps pull requests above the prompt: each chat's PRs, their +/- lines, build validation (CI) status, comments, auto-complete, auto-fix of failed builds and review comments, and a Create PR button, all through the Azure CLI (az repos / az pipelines).

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the PR, its builds and its comments are re-read while a PR is shown. 0 turns polling off (refresh with /ado-pr refresh).

mergeStrategy.title: Merge strategy for auto-complete
mergeStrategy.description: How "Auto-merge when ready" completes the PR: squash, or a merge commit (noFastForward).

deleteSourceBranch.title: Delete source branch on merge
deleteSourceBranch.description: Passed to az repos pr update --delete-source-branch when auto-complete is turned on.

azPython.title: Azure CLI python.exe (Windows only)
azPython.description: Path of the python.exe bundled with the Azure CLI. Empty: the standard MSI install locations are tried, then az through cmd.
